about: U8 plan Step 167 (L4-13): one row for every route the composed host mounts. A probed kind (owner-list, owner-read, owner-read-by-id, owner-event, asset, suspended) names its probe in frontend/e2e/u8-complete/isolation.spec.ts; every other kind says why it is not probed. notClaimed marks a probed row whose probe cannot fail in this realm. anonymous marks a row that answers a caller with no session: a guarded row its owner admits, or one of the two own reads on the public list. destinations are the navigation registry's paths.
